profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Specialties: C/C++, HTML, JavaScript, Java, and SQL
Kernel programming in Linux, OSX, and Windows.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed and supervised two separate software development teams. 
•	Developed job descriptions and requirements, worked with both internal and external recruiters, set salary and benefits, and did performance reviews.
•	Defined product requirements, set project priorities and schedules, wrote functional specifications.
•	Defined, assigned, and accepted user stories for agile development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architect for MediaGrid client
* designed, prototyped, and implemented client to server communication protocol
* created a cross platform kernel code base (Mac, Linux, Windows) for accessing the MediaGrid cluster to make the MediaGrid accessible through platform native file system calls

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Implemented a dynamic routing protocol for 1394
Added SNMP gateway for Omneon products
Designed and implemented a strategy for supporting multiple international character sets on the Omneon file system.
Created multiple Windows based applications with GUI for controlling the Omneon Video server for
* delayed playout
* scheduled playout
* scheduled record
Created a Windows FTP gateway that converted in memory from Quicktime to MXF and vice-versa.
Created a Windows based application with GUI to do perform FXP (FTP server to server) transfers between servers.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Inverse Network Technology measured and ranked dialup providers. The data Inverse collected was used to enforce SLA agreements between dialup providers and companies like Intuit and IBM. The data was also used to for 
I was the 2nd full time employee of company. I was the principal software architect and a developer of the Internet Measurement Services product which accounted for over 75% of the revenues of the company. I designed and lead the development 4 piece software system for measuring the connectivity and network performance of dialup providers.
The system included:
* data collection software which automatically downloaded config files from our HQ, automatically synchronized data collection with other devices at the same location for both fault tolerance and optimized data collection , drove 3rd party software to collect data and uploaded results all through a phone line.
* a server that handed out config files to remote test device, received data from test clients and paged operations on test device failure
* a prepossessing and data analysis tool that automatically parsed logs from test devices which included 3rd party logs and converted them into multiple records for insertion into a SQL database.
* SQL and VB tools to do data analysis and automated report generation
